title: Pipeline → DQ → quarantine → publish
description: Put a contract in front of a table: validate each batch, publish the clean rows, quarantine the rest with reasons, and alert on the quarantine rate.
implementation: Load the contract, compile rules to SQL (DuckDB) or Spark expressions.
Split into pass/fail with a stable `failure_reason`.
Publish the pass set; write the fail set to quarantine with provenance.
repo_structure:
pipeline-dq-quarantine/
  contract/orders.yml       # rules: not_null, unique, range, enum
  src/validate.py
  src/publish.py
  tests/test_quarantine.py
architecture:
batch ─▶ [contract check] ─┬─ pass ─▶ published/ (SLA-bearing)
                           └─ fail ─▶ quarantine/ (+reason, +source_file)
                                          │
                                          └─▶ alert on rate
